title: Subindices and subfactors of infinite groups and numbers
summary: The theory of subfactors of groups, together with the associated notions of subindices and index stability for groupsandtheirsubsets, hasrecentlybeenintroducedandsystematicallydeveloped. Theseconceptsexhibitdeepconnections with additive combinatorics and number theory, relating to important topics such as packing and covering numbers, syndetic sets, group diameters, special integer sequences (e.g., primes and Fibonacci numbers), and classical rational sequences (e.g., Bernoulli numbers). Following the initial paper presented in 2020, two subsequent works further investigated these ideas…
